segments.source: A DeepFake can be either an image or a video with sounds artificially created by a combination of machine learning algorithms.
segments.en: A DeepFake can be either an image or a video with sounds artificially created by a combination of machine learning algorithms.
segments.es: Un DeepFake puede ser una imagen o un vídeo con sonidos creados artificialmente mediante una combinación de algoritmos de aprendizaje automático.

segments.source: Similarities can be found between this technology and image editing software, however, it is a step further. It can create people that do not exist or create a video by making a real person say or do things they did not actually do or say, as in the case of the famous Obama video.
segments.en: Similarities can be found between this technology and image editing software, however, it is a step further. It can create people that do not exist or create a video by making a real person say or do things they did not actually do or say, as in the case of the famous Obama video.
segments.es: Se pueden encontrar similitudes entre esta tecnología y el software de edición de imágenes, sin embargo, es un paso más. Puede crear personas que no existen o crear un vídeo haciendo que una persona real diga o haga cosas que en realidad no hizo ni dijo, como en el caso del famoso vídeo de Obama.

segments.en: The motivation behind the project
segments.es: La motivación detrás del proyecto.

segments.source: Nowadays, it seems more and more difficult to detect if the content that is spread over the network is true and more and more difficult to detect what is real and what is not.
segments.en: Nowadays, it seems more and more difficult to detect if the content that is spread over the network is true and more and more difficult to detect what is real and what is not.
segments.es: Hoy en día parece cada vez más complicado detectar si el contenido que se difunde por la red es cierto y cada vez más complicado detectar qué es real y qué no.

segments.source: That is why the main motivation of our project is to develop a model for the detection of deepfakes that could help people, institutions, and companies to detect false images in situations where they can be manipulated.
segments.en: That is why the main motivation of our project is to develop a model for the detection of deepfakes that could help people, institutions, and companies to detect false images in situations where they can be manipulated.
segments.es: Es por ello que la principal motivación de nuestro proyecto es desarrollar un modelo de detección de deepfakes que pueda ayudar a personas, instituciones y empresas a detectar imágenes falsas en situaciones en las que puedan ser manipuladas.

The second stage is a FCN, which is used to obtain the candidate windows and their bounding box regression vectors.
segments.es: . En resumen, es un modelo de 3 etapas convolucionales consecutivas, en la que la primera es una CNN donde se toma la imagen y se redimensiona a diferentes escalas para construir una pirámide de imágenes. La segunda etapa es un FCN, que se utiliza para obtener las ventanas candidatas y sus vectores de regresión del cuadro delimitador.

segments.source: To help us understand the decisions of our model we have used Class Activation Maps to see what it is focusing on when it is analyzing an image. To do so, we have used the Grad-CAM method, which consists of finding which parts of the image have led a convolutional neural network to its final decision. This method consists of producing heat maps that represent the activation classes on the input images received. An activation class is associated with a specific output class. These classes will make it possible to indicate the importance of each pixel with respect to the class in question by increasing or decreasing the intensity of the pixel.
segments.en: To help us understand the decisions of our model we have used Class Activation Maps to see what it is focusing on when it is analyzing an image. To do so, we have used the Grad-CAM method, which consists of finding which parts of the image have led a convolutional neural network to its final decision. This method consists of producing heat maps that represent the activation classes on the input images received. An activation class is associated with a specific output class. These classes will make it possible to indicate the importance of each pixel with respect to the class in question by increasing or decreasing the intensity of the pixel.
segments.es: Para ayudarnos a comprender las decisiones de nuestro modelo, hemos utilizado mapas de activación de clase para ver en qué se centra cuando analiza una imagen. Para ello hemos utilizado el método Grad-CAM, que consiste en encontrar qué partes de la imagen han llevado a una red neuronal convolucional a su decisión final. Este método consiste en producir mapas de calor que representan las clases de activación sobre las imágenes de entrada recibidas. Una clase de activación está asociada con una clase de salida específica. Estas clases permitirán indicar la importancia de cada píxel con respecto a la clase en cuestión aumentando o disminuyendo la intensidad del píxel.

segments.source: During the project we have had a series of difficulties, the main one has been when performing the evaluation of the model, after the training phases, although the binary accuracy of both validations has shown a good result (96.39% after 10 epochs), when we tested the model, it erroneously classified all of them as “Real”. At first we attributed this error to the dataset, that after transformations, there were certain images that had defects, and that we had to download the videos to extract the faces with higher quality.
segments.en: During the project we have had a series of difficulties, the main one has been when performing the evaluation of the model, after the training phases, although the binary accuracy of both validations has shown a good result (96.39% after 10 epochs), when we tested the model, it erroneously classified all of them as “Real”. At first we attributed this error to the dataset, that after transformations, there were certain images that had defects, and that we had to download the videos to extract the faces with higher quality.
segments.es: Durante el proyecto hemos tenido una serie de dificultades, la principal ha sido a la hora de realizar la evaluación del modelo, tras las fases de entrenamiento, aunque la precisión binaria de ambas validaciones ha mostrado un buen resultado (96,39% tras 10 épocas), cuando probamos el modelo las clasificó erróneamente todas como “Reales”. Al principio atribuimos este error al conjunto de datos, que después de las transformaciones, había ciertas imágenes que tenían defectos y que teníamos que descargar los videos para extraer los rostros con mayor calidad.

segments.source: We finally solved it by filtering out the blurry images that were very detrimental to the training of the model. We avoided using transformations in the training dataset (only resize and convert to tensor). We extended the fake image dataset by filtering the blurred ones as described in the dataset section.
segments.en: We finally solved it by filtering out the blurry images that were very detrimental to the training of the model. We avoided using transformations in the training dataset (only resize and convert to tensor). We extended the fake image dataset by filtering the blurred ones as described in the dataset section.
segments.es: Finalmente lo solucionamos filtrando las imágenes borrosas que eran muy perjudiciales para el entrenamiento del modelo. Evitamos el uso de transformaciones en el conjunto de datos de entrenamiento (solo cambiar el tamaño y convertir a tensor). Ampliamos el conjunto de datos de imágenes falsas filtrando las borrosas como se describe en la sección del conjunto de datos.
